rules.sentence: Leiomyosarcoma is malignant mesenchymal smooth muscle tumor.
Histologically, leiomyosarcoma is composed of a proliferation of spindle cells with marked atypia, brisk mitotic activity with or without tumor necrosis (Figure 5B).
Immunohistochemically, both leiomyoma and leiomyosarcoma are positive for desmin and SMA, and are negative for DOG-1, C-KIT, S-100 and CD34.
